Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Rhodes Dining Arm Chair, Set of 2
Colors: Black
Materials: Aluminum
Set of 2 dining arm chairs for outdoor use; all-weather cushions with fabric ties to secure to frame Durable extruded-aluminum frames with black powder-coated finish; 100-percent polyester cushion covers No assembly required; imported; coordinates with other pieces from the Rhodes collection (sold separately) Spot clean cushions; cover/store during inclement weather; weight capacity of 250 pounds Each chair measures 25 inches long by 23 inches deep by 35.4 inches high
